namespacemanager-desc: Abuur oo maamul meelaha magaca ee gaarka ah si toos ah wiki-gaaga gudaheeda
managenamespaces-intro: Ku dar, wax ka beddel, ama ka saar meelaha magaca ee gaarka ah. Isbeddelladu waxay ku dhaqan geli doonaan codsiyada xiga.
namespacemanager-javascript-required: JavaScript ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo maamulo meelaha magaca.
namespacemanager-load-error: Meelaha magaca lama soo rari karin.
namespacemanager-empty: Lama habayn wax meelo magac oo gaar ah.
namespacemanager-save-success: Habaynta meelaha magaca waa la kaydiyey.
namespacemanager-save-error: Habaynta meelaha magaca lama kaydin karin. Sax meelaha la iftiimiyey oo isku day mar kale.
namespacemanager-id-help: Geli lambar labanlaab ah oo aan la isticmaalin oo u dhexeeya 3000 ilaa 4998. Lambarka kiga ah ee ku xiga waxaa loo qoondeeyey meesha magaca wada hadalka.
namespacemanager-name-help: Geli magaca rasmiga ah ee meesha magaca mawduuca. Firaaqooyinka waxaa loo beddelaa xariiq hoose, labo dhibcoodle lama oggola.
namespacemanager-talkname-help: Ka tag bannaan si loo isticmaalo magaca meesha magaca oo ay ku xigto “_talk”.
namespacemanager-talksearchdefault: Raadi meel magaca wada hadalka si caadi ah
namespacemanager-talksubpages: Hawl geli bog hoosaadyada wada hadalka
namespacemanager-talkincludable: U oggolow gudbin ku jirinta wada hadalka
namespacemanager-aliases-help: Geli magacyo kale oo loogu talagalay meel magaca mawduuca. Riix Enter magac kasta kadib.
namespacemanager-chip-description: Riix Enter si aad u darto shay. Riix Backspace si aad uga saarto shayga la doortay.
namespacemanager-talkaliases-help: Geli magacyo kale oo loogu talagalay meel magaca wada hadalka. Riix Enter magac kasta kadib.
namespacemanager-editpermissions: Xuquuqda tafatirka ee loo baahan yahay
namespacemanager-editpermissions-help: Geli xuquuqaha MediaWiki ee ay tahay inuu isticmaaluhu yeesho si uu wax uga beddelo bogagga ku jira meel magaca mawduuca. Riix Enter xuquuq kasta kadib.
namespacemanager-talkeditpermissions: Xuquuqda tafatirka wada hadalka ee loo baahan yahay
namespacemanager-talkeditpermissions-hel: Geli xuquuqaha MediaWiki ee ay tahay inuu isticmaaluhu yeesho si uu wax uga beddelo bogagga ku jira meel magaca wada hadalka. Riix Enter xuquuq kasta kadib.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-id: Isticmaal aqoonsi labanlaab ah oo aan la isticmaalin oo u dhexeeya 3000 ilaa 4998.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-name: Geli magac aan bannaanayn oo aan lahayn labo dhibcoodle.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-id: Aqoonsigan wuxuu ku dhacayaa isku dhac meel magac kale ama meel magac wada hadal kale.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-name: Magacan ama magac beddelkan wuxuu ku dhacayaa isku dhac meel magac kale.
namespacemanager-error-name-too-long: Isticmaal magac aan ka badnayn 255 bayt.
namespacemanager-error-field: Meeshan waxay ka kooban tahay qiime aan sax ahayn.
apihelp-namespacemanager-summary: Akhriyaa ama si otomaatig ah u beddelaa qeexitaannada NamespaceManager.
apihelp-namespacemanager-param-operation: Haddii la helo ama la kaydiyo qeexitaannada.
apihelp-namespacemanager-param-namespace: Safka JSON ah oo ka kooban qeexitaannada meelaha magaca ee hawlgalka kaydinta.
apihelp-namespacemanager-example-get: Hel dhammaan qeexitaannada meelaha magaca ee gaarka ah.
apihelp-namespacemanager-example-save: Ka saar dhammaan qeexitaannada meelaha magaca ee gaarka ah.
apierror-namespacemanager-invalid-json: Halbeegga meelaha magaca ma aha JSON sax ah.
apierror-namespacemanager-missing-namesp: Halbeegga meelaha magaca ayaa loo baahan yahay hawlgallada kaydinta.
apierror-namespacemanager-validation: Hal ama in ka badan oo ka mid ah qeexitaannada meel magaca ayaa khaldan.
